DRAFT FOR REVIEW

CONFIDENTIAL CASE BRIEF FOR LEGAL REVIEW

From: [SENDER NAME AND ADDRESS]
To: [RECIPIENT NAME AND ADDRESS]

Subject: Minor criminal charge with conflicting evidence (criminal defense)

MATERIAL FACTS

1. Imran Sheikh, 22, a college student, has been charged with causing hurt and minor property damage after a fight outside a café at around 10:40 pm on a Saturday. The complainant, Deepak Rawat, says Imran punched him in the face and smashed his phone on the pavement during an argument over a parking spot. Imran admits there was an argument but says Deepak shoved him first, that he only pushed back in self-defense, and that he never touched the phone. Deepak had a cut lip and a broken phone screen, and a police complaint was filed the same night.

2. Imran is out on bail and worried about the effect of a record on his scholarship and future job prospects. He wants to know how strong the case against him is, whether he can claim self-defense, whether he should accept a plea or settlement offer, and how to handle the police if they call him again. He says he has not given a statement beyond his first interview, which he gave without a lawyer.

OUTCOME SOUGHT AND QUESTIONS FOR COUNSEL

[Specify the requested action or relief]

ENCLOSURES

None

Place: [place]
Date: [date of signing]
Signature: ____________________
